problem: Learn transferable latent actions from heterogeneous actionless videos while reducing task-irrelevant visual motion, then adapt them to specific robot control spaces.
contribution: Primary PDF title is Learning to Act Anywhere with Task-centric Latent Actions; UniVLA is the system name. Two-stage vector-quantized feature prediction separates task-irrelevant and task-centric codes; a7BVLM predicts compactcodes and a target-trained decoder maps them to actualactions.
algorithm: DINOv2 pairedframefeatures at~1second spacing enter an inverse/forward latentaction model. Stage1 language-conditioned prediction trains task-irrelevantcodes; Stage2 freezes thatcodebook and introduces task-centriccodes withoutlanguage. Prismatic7B autoregressively predicts4codeindices. Posttraining uses visual-attention actiondecoder andLoRA with actionL1 plus next-codeprediction; previous4latenttokens enter nextprompt.
